issues.description: CI-only setuptools<82 workaround leaks into core/setup.py install_requires, constraining every downstream user.
issues.detail: All three reviewers flag this as the central issue. The pin exists to let mmcv 2.1.0 build in CI (pkg_resources removed in setuptools 82), but adding it to install_requires propagates the cap to every AutoGluon installer who never builds mmcv. Scope the pin to CI scripts or the mmcv/ray extra only.

issues.description: No removal criterion or upstream-issue link for the setuptools pin, especially in core/setup.py.
issues.detail: Shell FIXMEs cite mmcv#3325 but setup.py carries no breadcrumb, and no mechanism alerts the team when upstream ships a fix. Add the same FIXME with an explicit revert condition (mmcv release built against setuptools>=82) so the time-bound constraint does not rot silently across three sites.

issues.description: mmdet bumped from 3.2.0 to 3.3.0 with no stated justification.
issues.detail: The PR is framed as a setuptools/mmengine fix, but mmdet also moves a minor version in the same diff. No reviewer can tell whether 3.3.0 is required for compatibility with mmengine 0.10.7 or is incidental drift. Add a one-line comment justifying the bump so rollback is not guesswork.

issues.description: --no-build-isolation introduces an implicit, unstated coupling to the ambient setuptools.
issues.detail: Disabling build isolation is the actual mechanism by which the setuptools<82 cap takes effect for mmcv's build. The invariant (outer setuptools<82 must be installed first, in this interpreter, before mmcv) is brittle to step reordering and undocumented. A one-line comment would make this readable and maintainable.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a pragmatic CI unblock rather than a reasoned fix: pin setuptools<82 so mmcv 2.1.0's pkg_resources-dependent build still works, and switch from the mmengine git pin to a PyPI wheel. The shell-script changes are acceptable but under-audited. The consequential issue all three reviewers converge on is the leakage of the CI build constraint into core/setup.py install_requires, which imposes the cap on every downstream AutoGluon user. Secondary concerns are the missing removal criterion, an unjustified mmdet 3.2.0->3.3.0 bump, and the implicit coupling introduced by --no-build-isolation. Verdict: scope the pin to CI/extras, add FIXME breadcrumbs everywhere, justify the mmdet bump.
